loads.series: Gaia archive ADQL query: SELECT source_id, ra, dec, DISTANCE(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), POINT('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12)) AS dist_deg, parallax, parallax_error, parallax_over_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved, visibility_periods_used, phot_g_mean_mag, phot_g_mean_flux_over_error, phot_bp_mean_mag, phot_rp_mean_mag, bp_rp FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE 1 = CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS', ra, dec), CIRCLE('ICRS', 56.75, 24.12, 3)) AND parallax > 2 AND parallax_over_error > 5
